installCommand: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd site && npm ci
$comment_rewrites: THE ROUTE REWRITES (wave 13, function budget).
Vercel builds ONE FUNCTION per file under api/. The portal family used to
be nine files (nine functions) and the owner family two, which put the
deployment above the Hobby cap of twelve functions - the portal could not
be deployed at all. api/ now holds seven files:
api/contact.ts             -> /api/contact            (own file)
api/moderate/review.ts     -> /api/moderate/review    (own file)
api/portal.ts              -> nine /api/portal/* URLs
api/admin.ts               -> two /api/admin/* URLs
api/portal/auth/*.ts       -> the three sign-in URLs (own files)
The rewrites below send every family URL to its entry point and name the
ORIGINAL public path in the reserved query parameter __imk_route. The
entry point reads it back (site/shared/portal-router.ts) and rebuilds the
request URL, so the handler sees the path and the query string it expects.
THE SIGN-IN DOOR IS NOT REWRITTEN. /api/portal/auth/verify carries a
query string (?token=) and is the most security-sensitive surface in the
product, so it keeps a function file of its own and no rewrite can touch
it. /api/moderate/review is left alone for the same reason.
The rule this table must agree with is site/shared/portal-routes.json -
the machine-readable route table. site/scripts/check-api-routes.mjs fails
the build if the two ever disagree.
